_comment: D13-F8: READ-ONLY pins of D-12/D-14/D-15-owned behavior D-13 calls. Trace, never port — the owning domain's fixtures are authoritative for the implementation; these pins exist so D-13 layer implementers emit the right call shapes/keys.

auth_dev_machine.behavior: token = request.auth_machine_token; None when token missing OR token.dev_machine_id None OR str(token.dev_machine_id) != str(dev_machine_id); else token.dev_machine (the SELECTED-RELATED row, no new query)

close_runner_session.behavior: for each ACTIVE RunnerSession of the runner: revoked_at=now, revoked_reason='force_close' (save update_fields both); clear_session_marker(session.id); publish_session_eviction(runner_id, old_session_id, new_session_id=''). NOTE the `code` param (default 4010) is ACCEPTED but IGNORED — never written anywhere (port as-is: keep the arg, ignore it).

complete_project_move_handoff.called_as: complete_project_move_handoff(run_id) positionally, inside try/except Exception -> logger.exception (swallow). Return value ignored.
complete_project_move_handoff.resolved_lines: orchestration/service.py:644-... (def at :644; returns Optional[AgentRun]; locks issue row then source run row)

deactivate_api_token.behavior: falsy raw -> return 0 (no SQL). Else APIToken.objects.filter(token=raw, is_active=True)[.filter(description=CLI_DEVICE_API_TOKEN_DESCRIPTION) when only_cli_device_tokens].update(is_active=False, updated_at=now()); returns rowcount (ignored by D-13 caller).
deactivate_api_token.called_as: deactivate_api_token(request.auth, only_cli_device_tokens=True) — request.auth is the raw token string on the APIToken branch

drain_pod_by_id.behavior: pod = Pod.objects.filter(pk).first() (default manager: tombstones skipped -> return 0); else drain_pod(pod) (matching/assignment owned by D-12). Called via transaction.on_commit (post-commit, return ignored).

finalize_agent_run.called_as: finalize_agent_run(run_id, AgentRunStatus.CANCELLED, updates={'error': 'runner revoked', 'error_code': 'runner_revoked', 'cancel_reason': stored_reason}, expected_runner_id=runner.pk). Return ignored.
finalize_agent_run.signature: finalize_agent_run(run_id, new_status, *, updates=None, expected_runner_id=None, expected_status=None) -> bool. new_status MUST be terminal (else ValueError). First-writer-wins: locks the non-terminal row (+expected filters), updates status/ended_at/queue_position=None/terminal-hook NULLs + updates; cloud runs get a terminal AgentRunEvent; on_commit publishes terminal effects task.

machine_cmd_result.get: client None -> None (callers read as unknown_request). GET key; falsy -> None; bytes->decode; json.loads; unparseable -> None (swallowed).
machine_cmd_result.json: payloads are json.dumps(payload, default=str) — datetimes pre-isoformat()d by callers anyway
machine_cmd_result.set: client None -> logger.warning + return (SILENT drop — status endpoint later reads unknown_request). Else SET key json EX 900.

method: Call shapes, key strings, TTLs and predicate logic transcribed from the cited (owned-elsewhere) sources at the pinned lines; D-13 call sites noted. No DB/Redis touched.

value: waiting_for_worktree (retired PDASHOSS01-137 but KEPT for historical rows)

send_runner_remove.frame: {'type': 'remove_runner', 'runner_id': str(runner_id), 'reason': reason} — NOTE: includes runner_id IN the body (revoke does not)

send_runner_revoke.frame: {'type': 'revoke', 'reason': reason} — NO runner_id, NO mid envelope (unlike send_to_runner)
send_runner_revoke.offline_note: revoke is offline-allowed; RunnerOfflineError only logged defensively

send_to_machine.offline: create_runner/config_push are OFFLINE-REJECT: raise MachineOfflineError (propagates to D-13 caller -> 409). None return = Redis unavailable, nothing delivered (-> 503). Other Redis errors PROPAGATE (NOT swallowed — unlike send_to_runner).
send_to_machine.shape: (dev_machine_id, message: dict) -> str | None; message gets mid envelope via _ensure_envelope (mid=uuid4 str when absent)

send_to_runner.returns: None (fire-and-forget); RunnerOfflineError RE-RAISED for offline-rejected types (assign/cancel/decide/resume_ack); all other exceptions LOGGED and swallowed
send_to_runner.shape: (runner_id, message: dict) -> None; message gets mid envelope via _ensure_envelope (mid=uuid4 str when absent)

redis_instance_none.note: Production redis_instance() (settings/redis.py:64-117) RAISES RuntimeError when REDIS_URL is unset — it NEVER returns None. Every `client is None` branch D-13 codes (ticket 201-without-write, redeem 503, outbox silent drops) is reachable only when tests mock redis_instance to None. Port the None-handling EXACTLY as coded (the contract tests drive it via mocks/fakes), but do not treat None as a production state.

request_is_desktop.behavior: EE gate (ee/authentication/desktop.py:25) deciding IsDesktopSession; D-13 records only the denial body (see F4), never the predicate internals

schedule_stream_cleanup_for_runner.behavior: client None -> silent return. Else grace = 2 * ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECS (default 7200s); ZADD runner_stream_cleanup {str(runner_id): now+grace}. Called via transaction.on_commit from Runner.revoke (ALWAYS, even with zero affected runs).
